name: WRF
summary: The Weather Research and Forecasting model; this Hub bundle covers ten pinned idealized meteorology cases.
scope: Selected DIPL controls and native-input staging for ten WRF v4.8.0 idealized examples, spanning 2D, 3D, and global configurations.
validation_qualifier: Generated namelists and staged source assets match ten pinned WRF v4.8.0 idealized examples. Build, execution, and scientific outputs have not been checked; every recipe is native-inputs-only.
limitations: This independent adapter models selected controls in ten idealized WRF cases; LES, SCM, fire, real-data, and ESMF coupling families are outside its current scope. Unmodeled namelist entries are retained from the pinned source. Staged inputs are not a complete WRF runtime directory; build, ideal.exe, wrf.exe, external data assets, and scientific results remain unverified. No upstream maintainer endorsement is implied.
